title: ProBoy-MD
summary: An open-source Node.js WhatsApp Multi-Device automation bot developed by Shahan Ali (proboy315) with 224 verified command files across 9 categories.
description: ProBoy-MD is a modular Node.js WhatsApp Multi-Device bot built on the Baileys library by Shahan Ali (PROBOY).

It organizes 224 command files across nine functional categories — general, AI helpers, group moderation, media processing, text effects, utilities, and developer tools — using pairing-code authentication.
features: Multi-device WhatsApp session management via Baileys
Pairing-code login workflow without QR scanning
Group moderation, media conversion, and Gemini AI helpers
creator: Shahan Ali

title: ProBoy CamLink
summary: A camera shortlink and browser diagnostic utility with device telemetry logs and capture session management.
description: ProBoy CamLink generates browser-based diagnostic shortlinks for testing camera permissions and device capabilities.
It pairs a lightweight capture frontend with a control panel for inspecting diagnostic logs and session outputs.
features: Dynamic shortlink generation for browser permission testing
Real-time device and browser diagnostic telemetry
Session control panel and capture review
creator: Shahan Ali

title: ProBoy JS Obfuscator
summary: A client-side JavaScript obfuscation utility for transforming and hardening browser-delivered source code.
description: ProBoy JS Obfuscator is a browser-based utility for encoding and obfuscating JavaScript source files locally without uploading proprietary code to third-party servers.
Designed for quick bundling checks and source protection workflows.
features: Configurable identifier mangling and string encoding
creator: Shahan Ali

title: ProBoy Encrypt & Decrypt
summary: A browser-native AES-256-GCM encryption suite with image steganography and a local encrypted history vault.
description: ProBoy Encrypt & Decrypt uses the Web Crypto API to encrypt and decrypt sensitive text messages with AES-256-GCM directly in the browser.
It also supports LSB image steganography for embedding encrypted payloads inside PNG images alongside a local browser vault.
features: Image steganography for embedding hidden payloads
creator: Shahan Ali

title: ProBoy-SiM_Database
summary: A structured lookup interface for browsing simulation records and cellular activation datasets.
description: ProBoy-SiM_Database is a structured query interface built to search and filter simulation database records and activation reports.
It features an interactive tabular layout designed for fast record lookup and API-backed synchronization.
creator: Shahan Ali
